Ringkøbing-Skjern is a Danish municipality included in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP). The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatments across the Danish healthcare system, breaking down national data by region and all 98 municipalities to support local quality development and benchmarking.

In the available corpus, Ringkøbing-Skjern is mentioned exclusively within statistical tables for specific quality indicators. It appears in the data for Indicators 4a and 4b, which assess anticoagulation treatment coverage over time (1, 2, and 5 years post-diagnosis) and safety practices regarding DOAC medications [^src2]. Additionally, the municipality is listed in the calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulation treatment using DanStroke registry data [^src1]. 

Because the available evidence consists solely of these tabular data points, no further narrative details, specific claims, relationships, or chronological events are documented for Ringkøbing-Skjern.
